scope: Read-only audit of historical learning records, not a production mistake rate. No raw user conversations or private model reasoning are included.
interpretation: Eight stored event records are not eight independently confirmed mistakes. The same thread can produce multiple records.
Only three records are explicitly associated with production threads; one is development and four lack environment metadata.
The old detector selected only unavailable/debug-vocabulary patterns, so their observed frequency is selection-biased.
A no-change reassessment rejects the vocabulary-cause premise for a missing follow-up answer.
All eight historical records share the old canned correction summary; this is inherited templating, not eight independently derived lessons.
The four local learning scenarios are separate from these database records; one is derived from a real DEV output, one scripts a fictional error, two are scripted controls.
